The '''A95 Stingbeam''', produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], was a compact and easily concealable energy weapon, among the smallest [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] available. Small enough to fit in the palm of a hand, it operated similarly to a traditional blaster but focused its blast along a needle-like rod between the user’s fingers. Effective at close range, the A95 Stingbeam was capable of lethal force, though its blasts quickly lost cohesion over distance.<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The A95 Stingbeam was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
